proposed_scenarios.description: Complete successful authentication workflow using valid Atlassian credentials to access zbio Jira instance
proposed_scenarios.business_goal: Verify users can successfully authenticate with valid Atlassian credentials and access the Jira workspace
proposed_scenarios.user_story: As a registered team member, I want to log in with my Atlassian credentials so that I can access the zbio Jira workspace and manage projects

detailed_steps.description: Navigate to zbio.atlassian.net homepage which redirects to Atlassian ID login
detailed_steps.verification_point: Page redirects to Atlassian ID login portal with continue parameter for zbio.atlassian.net
detailed_steps.business_impact: User is directed to centralized Atlassian authentication

detailed_steps.description: Pause for manual entry of valid Atlassian email/username on login form
detailed_steps.pause_message: ⏸️ TEST PAUSED: Please enter your Atlassian email/username in the login form. Press Enter to continue...
detailed_steps.verification_point: Username field accepts valid email address format
detailed_steps.business_impact: User can identify their account for authentication

detailed_steps.description: Pause for manual entry of valid password and form submission
detailed_steps.pause_message: ⏸️ TEST PAUSED: Please enter your password and click 'Continue' or press Enter to submit. Press Enter to continue test...
detailed_steps.verification_point: Password field masks input and login button is clickable

detailed_steps.description: Verify successful authentication and redirect to zbio.atlassian.net Jira workspace
detailed_steps.verification_point: URL changes from id.atlassian.com to zbio.atlassian.net after successful authentication
detailed_steps.business_impact: User successfully authenticated and granted access to Jira workspace

detailed_steps.description: Verify authenticated state by confirming page title and URL stability
detailed_steps.verification_point: Page title indicates authenticated Jira workspace and URL remains on zbio.atlassian.net domain
detailed_steps.business_impact: User successfully reached authenticated area and can access Jira features

expected_results: User successfully navigates to Atlassian ID login page
Login form accepts valid credentials without errors
Authentication processes successfully with valid credentials
User is redirected to zbio.atlassian.net Jira workspace after authentication
Authenticated session is established and page loads successfully
No security errors or authentication failures occur during the workflow
edge_cases_to_test: What happens if session expires during login process
How does system handle slow network during authentication redirect
What if user navigates back during authentication flow
How does login handle multiple concurrent login attempts
data_requirements: Valid Atlassian account credentials with access to zbio.atlassian.net
Active user account that has been granted Jira workspace permissions
Test account credentials stored in environment variables for security
prerequisites: zbio.atlassian.net Jira instance is accessible and operational
Atlassian ID authentication service (id.atlassian.com) is functional
Test user account exists and has active permissions for zbio workspace
Network allows access to Atlassian domains
